research_axis_1_orographic_dynamics.core_hypothesis: POLARIS is missing a physical description of the atmospheric flow regime controlling cloud formation, blocking, uplift, persistence, and propagation over Mount Nuolja.

candidates_evaluated.name: Scandes Barrier-Normal Wind Component (U_perp)
candidates_evaluated.formula: U_perp = u700 * sin(200 deg) + v700 * cos(200 deg)
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Forced cross-barrier moist air mass transport impinging on Nuolja western slope
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Genuinely novel. Stage 8.1 contains raw Cartesian winds (u700, v700). Decision trees cannot compute rotated vector dot-products.
candidates_evaluated.target_failure_mode: Fails to distinguish mountain-perpendicular forced uplift from ridge-parallel along-valley winds
candidates_evaluated.classification: A. GENUINELY NOVEL + CAUSALLY FEASIBLE + BENCHMARK FEASIBLE

candidates_evaluated.name: Mountain Froude Number (Fr = U_perp / (N * h))
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Ratio of kinetic energy to potential energy for flow over Scandes obstacle; discriminates blocked low-level valley cloud (Fr < 1) from over-topping wave cloud (Fr >= 1)
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Genuinely novel. Unites wind direction, static stability, and terrain geometry into a non-dimensional flow regime index.
candidates_evaluated.target_failure_mode: Fails on flow-regime transitions between valley stagnation and mountain-wave cap cloud over-topping
candidates_evaluated.classification: A. GENUINELY NOVEL + CAUSALLY FEASIBLE + BENCHMARK FEASIBLE

candidates_evaluated.name: Moist Mountain Froude Number (Fr_m)
candidates_evaluated.formula: Fr_m = U_perp / (N_m * h), with latent heat stability reduction
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Conditionally unstable moist stability flow over-topping regime
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Genuinely novel moist thermodynamic flow-regime indicator
candidates_evaluated.target_failure_mode: Moist convective cloud formation over Nuolja slope
candidates_evaluated.classification: A. GENUINELY NOVEL + CAUSALLY FEASIBLE + BENCHMARK FEASIBLE

candidates_evaluated.name: Orographic Kinematic Uplift Rate (w_oro)
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Forced adiabatic cooling and condensation rate along Nuolja mountain slope
candidates_evaluated.target_failure_mode: Slope forced condensation vs clear-sky descent
candidates_evaluated.classification: A. GENUINELY NOVEL + CAUSALLY FEASIBLE + BENCHMARK FEASIBLE

candidates_evaluated.name: Low-Level Wind Shear Layer (delta_V_shear)
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Boundary-layer mechanical turbulence and valley-to-summit shear mixing
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Partially novel, but tree interactions on u700/v700 and fc_wind_speed_10m approximate shear
candidates_evaluated.classification: B. SCIENTIFICALLY INTERESTING BUT NOT SUFFICIENTLY NOVEL

research_axis_2_cloud_evolution.core_hypothesis: POLARIS lacks a causal indicator of cloud condensate growth/decay prior to t0.

candidates_evaluated.name: Inter-Run MEPS Cloud Condensate Tendency (delta_LWP_run)
candidates_evaluated.formula: LWP_D0(t) - LWP_D1(t) for matching forecast valid times
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: NWP physics engine cloud build-up / dissipation rate between consecutive MEPS forecast issuances prior to t0
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Genuinely novel model physics tendency operator
candidates_evaluated.classification: A. GENUINELY NOVEL + CAUSALLY FEASIBLE + BENCHMARK FEASIBLE

candidates_evaluated.name: Pre-t0 Surface Transmissivity Rate (dk_t/dt)
candidates_evaluated.formula: Rate of change of k_t in hours t0-3h to t0
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Observational cloud optical thickness rate of change prior to t0
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Fails during sub-Arctic polar night and midnight t0=00:00 UTC

research_axis_3_diffuse_broken_cloud.core_hypothesis: POLARIS lacks an explicit non-linear cloud-edge perimeter and diffuse radiation enhancement proxy.

candidates_evaluated.name: Broken-Cloud Diffuse Enhancement Index (I_diffuse)
candidates_evaluated.physical_process: Cloud-edge perimeter and side-scattering diffuse GHI enhancement
candidates_evaluated.novelty_vs_stage8_1: Approximated by deep tree splits on existing cloud_frac and clearsky_ghi features
candidates_evaluated.classification: B. SCIENTIFICALLY INTERESTING BUT NOT SUFFICIENTLY NOVEL
